1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body having a cross-sectional shape selected from the group consisting of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open and includes a protective covering that prevents debris from entering said columnar body.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are radially disposed around the columnar body at varying distances from the first end.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are arranged non-uniformly between said diodes to optimize thermal dissipation.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face, and wherein each face is substantially flat.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/ mK.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current and includes a wireless control module for adjusting light intensity. 

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins arranged to enhance the cooling efficiency of the lamp.
